question.prompt: Quadrilateral \(ABCD\) is similar to quadrilateral \(A'B'C'D'\) (vertices correspond in order). Given \(\angle A=80^\circ\), \(\angle B=95^\circ\), and \(\angle C=100^\circ\), find the degree measure of \(\angle D'\).

solutions.explanation: Corresponding angles of similar polygons are equal, so \(\angle D'=\angle D\). The sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral is \(360^\circ\), so \(\angle D=360^\circ-80^\circ-95^\circ-100^\circ=85^\circ\).
solutions.title: Use corresponding angles and the angle sum
